title: wiretap: NetLog: Reject files with bogus junk
description:
A Chrome NetLog file is a JSON object that starts with a member
"constants". There is also an "events" member, and possibly
"polledEvents". Do a quick read of the first two JSON tokens,
and if the file doesn't start with an object and a name which
is one of those three then reject the file. (The first member
SHOULD be "constants", since that's how Chrome writes the file,
but it's possible that someone has read the JSON and written it
back out with the object members in a different order.) The
ordinary JSON wiretap module will handle it instead. This avoids
some time-intensive parsing of extra heavily nested junk extra
members as in the PoC in #21462.

https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/HEAD:net/log/file_net_log_observer.cc
